list_consumables.sql: SELECT item_name, unit_of_measurement, current_balance FROM gc_view_main_stock_balance WHERE 1=1

list_machinery.sql: SELECT name as machine_name, make, status FROM turf_machines WHERE 1=1

list_turf_consumption_log.sql: SELECT tcl.log_date, tm.name as machine_name, tcl.recorded_by as operator, tcl.fuel_consumed_qty, tcl.running_hours FROM turf_consumption_log tcl JOIN turf_machines tm ON tcl.machine_id = tm.id WHERE 1=1

report_monthly_consumption.sql: SELECT m.name as machine_name, SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) as total_fuel_consumed FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id WHERE 1=1

report_consumption_trend.sql: SELECT to_char(c.log_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) as total_consumed FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id JOIN turf_inventory_items i ON m.fuel_item_id = i.id WHERE 1=1
report_consumption_trend.group_by: GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

list_with_ordering.sql: SELECT tcl.log_date, tm.name as machine_name, tcl.recorded_by as operator, tcl.fuel_consumed_qty, tcl.running_hours FROM turf_consumption_log tcl JOIN turf_machines tm ON tcl.machine_id = tm.id WHERE 1=1
